description: This file defines a Next.js page component for displaying details of a specific movie, including its poster, description, genre, release date, rating, and showtimes. It includes static parameter generation for static site generation, a client component for selecting showtimes and linking to a booking page, and a main page component rendering the movie details.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Provides static parameters for Next.js static site generation, returning a list with a single movie id.

methods.name: MovieShowtimes
methods.description: Client component for displaying showtimes, allowing selection and linking to booking.

methods.name: MovieDetailsPage
methods.description: Main component that renders movie details, poster, and showtimes.
